label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (java/xss): alert-TP — resolved sink value is attacker-controlled: The user-provided header value flows through URL decoding, the doSomething() method, and finally to the HTML response via encodeForHTML(). Even though encodeForHTML() is called, the data reaching the sink is still derived from the user-provided header, making it vulnerable to XSS. Case TP: at least one alert-TP.

evidence.note: User-provided header value retrieved via getHeaders()
Header value URL decoded and assigned to param
User-controlled param reaches HTML response via encodeForHTML()
